params.message:
Remove the Vera hand from admit: the workbench is the only hand words are signed for

Vera, the review product, is gone, and Portal no longer keeps a word signed
for #agent-vera. hand.mjs admit drops --hand vera and --act (a word for one
act only ever existed for that hand), admittedKinds drops its Vera branch,
and the comments that pointed at Vera's machine now name the workbench at
home, which is the other machine that fetches an admission from Portal.
